This is unsupported, and the scene itself later puts the camp on a distant horizon."},{"span":"the charred remains of their shared gear","severity":"major","reason":"Invents a fire and shared possessions the briefing never mentions."},{"span":"the broken weapon","severity":"minor","reason":"Adds an unmentioned object, presumably Joska's, as a fact."},{"span":"Lene’s face, etched with exhaustion, was visible in the shadows.","severity":"minor","reason":"Places Lene in the scene and describes her state, neither of which the briefing gives."}],"voice":3,"clarity":2,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The setting contradicts itself: Tamsin is at the Lancers' camp and also gazing at it on a distant horizon.
